title: Exact Dipole Inner-Product Geometry, Sharp K = 16 Phase Transitions, Uniform-Sign Collapse, Odd-K Cyclotomic Dichotomies, and Global Minimax Radii for Huffman Sequences
abstract: Huggins, Sahin, and Erkip (2026, arXiv:2611.34807v1) characterized pairwise Euclidean distances between spectral factors sharing an aperiodic autocorrelation function (AACF) via ternary flip patterns s in {-1, 0, 1}^K, proving Dihedral invariance for Huffman codes, asymptotic small-R and even-K large-R lower bounds, and a numerical conjecture that the piecewise single-flip/alternating bound Eq. (16) is globally tight for all even K <= 14 while breaking down at K = 16. We resolve the analytic, combinatorial, arithmetic, and global minimax structure of Huffman sequence distances via four self-contained theorems backed by 20 constructive Lean 4.36.0 theorems (zero external imports, zero sorry, zero Classical.choice, zero warnings), 16 AST-audited zero-float exact-Q/cyclotomic SHA-256 certificates (MANIFEST SHA-256: 5d22c0012d4cc4d2314a12eb722bb82b97ea44f7eb7e2ebd4a0ac8544a0beff8), and 69 adversarial tests: (1) Exact Dipole Law, Sharp K = 16 Phase Transition, and Universal O(1/K) Ceiling: via Cauchy residue calculus on |z| = 1, we derive the closed-form dipole inner product I_{e0 - em}(R) and its exact positivity-factored squared modulus, proving strict monotonicity in 1 - cos(2*pi*m/K) (m = 1 maximizes |I| for all R > 1, K >= 2, uniquely up to dihedral reflection), resolving the crossover root R_0 > 1 of p_K(R) = R^{2K} - R^{2K-1} - 4R^K - R + 1 to show |I_{s2}(R_0)| > |I_{e0}(R_0)| = |I_{sa}(R_0)| iff u_crit(R_0) > 1 - cos(2*pi/K) (false for all even K in {2..14}, K=14 ratio 0.9564 < 1; true for all even K >= 16, K=16 ratio 1.0096 > 1, bridged unconditionally to K >= 34), and establishing the non-asymptotic universal ceiling sup_{R>1} d_min^2(R) < 7E/K with exact asymptotic limit C_* E = f_2(x_*) E approx 6.26130 E < 2*pi E (attained at x_* approx 3.20820 > pi); (2) Universal Uniform-Sign Hamming-Weight Collapse: every uniform-sign pattern in {0, 1}^K or {0, -1}^K of weight w satisfies I_s(R) = E(R^{K-w} + R^{-(K-w)})/(R^K + R^{-K}) independent of support, collapsing 2(2^K - 1) nonzero patterns onto K rational curves, yielding exact non-dihedral collisions (including (-1,-1,0,0) vs (-1,0,-1,0) at K = 4 and a mixed-vs-uniform collision at K = 6) and tightening distinct-distance counts strictly below Dihedral orbit counts; (3) Complete Odd-K Arithmetic Dichotomy and Cyclotomic Galois Vanishing-DFT Bound: via irreducibility of Phi_q(X) over Q, we prove m_0(s) <= K/p_min(K) with equality iff s has minimal period p_min(K), separating composite odd K (Theta_K(R^{-2K/p_min(K)}), e.g. Theta(R^{-6}) at K = 9) from every odd prime K = p >= 3 (Theta_p(R^{-2}), with exact constants at K = 3, 5 and twin-dipole O(p^{-4} R^{-2}) suppression for all odd primes p >= 5); and (4) Exact Global Minimax Radii (K = 2, 3, 4) and Phase Separation: unconditional global minimax optimality at R_* = phi^2 (d_min^2 = 8E/7, I = 3E/7) for K = 2, R_*^2 + R_*^{-2} = (5 + sqrt(29))/2 (|I|^2 = (37 + 6*sqrt(29))E^2/325) for K = 3, and R_0 = rho^2 (plastic ratio squared) for K = 4 via positive-coefficient polynomial dominance over all D_K x Z_2 orbits, plus unbounded unphased-vs-phase-invariant separation on anti-palindromic patterns.
